name: Algeria
description: Algeria from the rock art of Tassili and Numidia to Rome, Islam, the Ottomans, French rule, the war of independence and today.

checkpoints.name: Ancient Algeria
checkpoints.note: Painters left herds on the rocks of Tassili. Numidian kings dealt with Carthage and Rome, Augustine was bishop at Hippo, and Arab armies brought Islam.

checkpoints.name: Corsairs
checkpoints.note: Algiers became an Ottoman base for corsairs who raided the Mediterranean.

checkpoints.name: French Algeria
checkpoints.note: France invaded in 1830 and fought Abdelkader. Settlers took the best land, and the war of independence began in 1954.

checkpoints.name: Independent Algeria
checkpoints.note: Algeria won independence in 1962. A civil war tore the 1990s, and protests in 2019 ended Bouteflika's rule.
